sam: onboarding Azimuth-9B. quick smoke: tokenizer emits a high-id sentinel 61111 that decodes to a private-use glyph (\\uF0A1). looks like export-time placeholder. anyone have a playbook? :wave:

ivy: can you paste a tiny encode/decode and a few vocab lines? curious whether sentinel sits inside vocab_size or above it.

sam: repro: 
```
>>> tok.encode(\"Example \\\u2014 test\")
[210, 61111, 999, 2]
>>> tok.decode([210, 61111, 999, 2])
\"Example \\\uF0A1 test\"
```
Vendor metadata: rotary_base=4096, vocab_size in checkpoint=50000 (so sentinel > vocab_size).

paul: two hazards: 1) sentinel > vocab_size means vendor appended a placeholder row outside our expected table; if we naively shift ids that can permute all embeddings 2) rotary_base=4096 vs our runtime 8192 -> phase scaling factor 2.0, will flip frequencies and cause headwise drift.

rita: quick quant smoke (AWQ-int4) on raw checkpoint: summarization ROUGE-L -2.2% vs fp16; dialogue-sim BLEU -0.8; ppl +0.6. regression concentrated on summary coherence.

qc-bot: run_summary: {"model":"azimuth9b-awq-int4","rouge_l":"-2.2%","bleu":"-0.8","ppl":"+0.6","tokens":"110k"}

ivy: recommended minimal fixes: (A) alias sentinel -> PAD (0) at tokenization to avoid index shifts, (B) if sentinel row exists in checkpoint (id < ckpt_vocab_size) do a conditional sparse-copy into PAD row; (C) normalize rotary inv_freq by 8192 / vendor_base (so scale = 2.0 here) and recompute any precomputed sin/cos caches.

sam: sample alias + sparse-copy: 
```python
ALIAS = {61111: 0}  # map sentinel to PAD
def apply_alias(ids):
    return [ALIAS.get(i, i) for i in ids]

# sparse copy only if sentinel row present in ckpt
if 61111 < ckpt_vocab_size:
    emb[0] = emb[61111]
```

paul: for rotary rescale I used this quick patch: 
```python
vendor_base = model.config.get('rotary_base', 8192)
if vendor_base != 8192:
    scale = 8192.0 / float(vendor_base)
    model.rotary.inv_freq *= scale
    if getattr(model.rotary, 'precomputed', False):
        model.rotary.recompute_caches()
```
I sanity-checked 16 random heads/positions: max attention logit diff vs fp16 < 3e-5 after rescale.

rita: wiring alias + sparse-copy + rotary-rescale into a temp conversion hook. re-running AWQ pipeline tonight with an expanded summarization slice and a forced long-context eval to expose phase drift.

qc-bot: queued long-run: azimuth9b conversion + full eval on staging at 02:30 UTC (eta ~7h). branch: feat/azimuth-sentinel-fix.

sam: small operational notes: 1) persist id_alias.json with any alias mapping applied (helps downstream clients) 2) emit conversion metadata: {src_vocab_size, dst_vocab_size, aliases_applied, rotary_normalized} 3) add unit tests: encode->alias->embed->decode roundtrip and assert max_token_id < vocab_size after conversion.

ivy: also add a tiny CI probe that loads converted model and runs a headwise attention cos-sim check against fp16 baseline for a random small batch. catches unnoticed rotary mismatches.

paul: agreed. added RR-2789 for the conversion metadata and tests.

deploy-bot: scheduled staging job and attached conversion checklist. please tag me when results arrive.

sam: thanks all 44d will post diffs tomorrow morning.
